common_gotchas: Official OP Snippets are launched in TouchDesigner rather than as individual public web pages; keep access_path explicit.
Particle POP examples should preserve feedback-loop state attributes such as PartForce and PartVel unless the snippet intentionally resets the simulation.
Force Radial POP accumulates PartForce when PartForce already exists, so stacked force nodes add together.
